title: cyberattack-first-response-sme-hero
subject: A composed IT-responsible person in a small business calmly works through a printed emergency checklist next to a disconnected laptop with an unplugged network cable, symbolising a controlled first response to a cyberattack — structure and preparedness instead of panic.
context: Beraterium blog hero for the article on immediate response after a cyberattack on an SME: the first 2 hours, isolation of systems, reporting duties (BSI, police, data protection) and prevention without an IT department. Theme: acting on a prepared plan under pressure. Warm, professional B2B editorial, controlled and confident, explicitly NOT a hacker-hoodie or matrix-code cliché.

platform_website.optimized_variants: Build creates cyberangriff-was-tun-kmu-hero.webp plus -480w, -960w, -1440w responsive WebP from the PNG source
platform_website.best_practice_notes: Wide 16:9 hero; person plus printed checklist and unplugged cable as focal story; generous negative space in upper third; readable at thumbnail and full width.
platform_website.safe_zone: Keep main subject in central 90% width; avoid critical detail in extreme left/right 5% and bottom 10%.

composition.depth: foreground printed checklist on clipboard and an unplugged network cable on the desk, midground focused person on a phone call taking notes, soft background small modern office with a second dimmed monitor

lighting.style: cool-neutral office light balanced with a warm desk lamp accent

style.mood: urgent but controlled — following a prepared plan, not panicking

ai_disclosure.placement: small legible label in the bottom-right corner of the image; never alt-text only
ai_disclosure.prompt_instruction: Small legible caption text 'KI-generiertes Bild' in the bottom-right corner: small clean sans-serif, white at ~70% opacity, unobtrusive but readable.

optional_text_overlay.typography: Prefer no text on image — article H1 renders above hero.
optional_text_overlay.prompt_instruction: No readable text on the checklist or screens; abstract checkbox rows only, top rows ticked.

negative_prompt: no watermarks or text except the small AI-disclosure label bottom right
no readable text on paper or screens (only exception: the small AI-disclosure label bottom right)
no green matrix code or skull icons
no identifiable real persons or celebrities

seo.alt_text: IT-Verantwortlicher in einem KMU arbeitet konzentriert eine Notfall-Checkliste nach einem Cyberangriff ab
seo.caption: Die ersten 2 Stunden nach einem Cyberangriff: isolieren, Experten rufen, melden – nach Plan statt Panik.
seo.image_title: Cyberangriff auf mein Unternehmen: Soforthilfe für KMU

generation_prompt_single_block_en: Landscape editorial photograph 1920x1080, 16:9. Small modern office, navy charcoal tones (#1F2A44) with cyan (#00A3FF) and amber (#F2B134) accents. Midground: composed IT-responsible person in smart casual on a phone call, taking notes, working through a printed emergency checklist on a clipboard. Foreground: the clipboard with abstract checkbox rows (top rows ticked, no readable text) and an unplugged network cable lying on the desk beside a closed laptop. Background: softly blurred second monitor, dimmed. Cool-neutral office light from left balanced with warm desk lamp accent, medium contrast, urgent-but-controlled mood — following a prepared plan, not panicking. Generous negative space upper third for blog header. Clean editorial realism, medium-high detail. In the bottom-right corner add a small legible caption text 'KI-generiertes Bild' in a small clean sans-serif, white at about 70% opacity — unobtrusive but readable at full width and thumbnail size. No hacker hoodie, no matrix code, no skull icons, no red alarm lighting, no other readable text, no watermarks, no third-party logos, no distorted hands. Safe zone: main subject central 90% width.
